newsitem.title: USA: Abercrombie & Fitch to test catalog sales.
newsitem.headline: Abercrombie & Fitch to test catalog sales.

text.p: Abercrombie & Fitch Co said Tuesday it will begin testing this summer a combination magazine/catalog, including both articles and information to order its classic casual sportswear.

At the company's first annual shareholder meeting since its initial public offering in September 1996, Abercrombie & Fitch president Michael Jeffries said the company will launch its first mailing of 400,000 copies on July 15. Another test mailing is expected this autumn, Jeffries said.
The company also said it plans to expand its women's line, adding underwear, loungewear, and more accessories and personal care products.
Jeffries said Abercrombie & Fitch is currently testing a women's underwear line in some areas, but a full-scale introduction is not expected until early 1998.
He said, however, the company's focus remains on key classifications -- sweaters, cut and sewn knitwear, shirts and casual bottoms -- and the expansion will be slow and careful.
"Because we're a brand, we can sell many things," Jeffries said. "There is a temptation to start selling things very quickly."
